description: A 30 m Warren truss road bridge (Truss2D: nodes, bars and supports as matrices; co-rotational bars that fail in tension at fy A and in compression at the Euler load). Statics against the method of joints, the first bending frequency against the eigenvalue problem, the energy balance, a strut that buckles at the Euler load, and a lorry on compliant tyres that snaps the undersized diagonal (bar 13) only when it is heavy enough. Reference numbers: design/design.py (numpy, no bg-sim code).
